title: Analista de Estratégia de Mercado
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional para integrar nossa equipe como Analista de Estratégia de Mercado, com foco em análise de dados, desenvolvimento de estratégias e ações promocionais, para impulsionar o crescimento de nosso negócio. Esta posição será responsável por identificar oportunidades de mercado, desenvolver planos comerciais e colaborar com equipes internas e externas para maximizar o impacto das campanhas e ações promocionais.

ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Realizar análises de mercado, identificar tendências, comportamento dos consumidores e dados de vendas para fornecer insights estratégicos que impulsionem o crescimento e a performance do negócio.
  • Desenvolver e implementar planos comerciais para captar novos clientes, com foco em aumento de vendas e fortalecimento da presença da empresa no mercado.
  • Criar, desenvolver e implementar campanhas promocionais, incluindo a elaboração de layouts criativos e materiais de marketing eficazes para as campanhas.
  • Manter comunicação contínua com clientes para tirar dúvidas sobre a plataforma, identificar novas oportunidades e promover a fidelização. Também apoiará nas negociações de ações e verbas promocionais com fornecedores, especialmente para o portal de vendas.
  • Acompanhar e relatar resultados de vendas, utilizando relatórios e dashboards com indicadores de performance, propondo ajustes nas ações com base nas análises realizadas.
  • Atualizar sistemas internos com preços, promoções e informações de campanhas, garantindo que todas as ações sejam executadas de forma organizada e eficiente.

REQUISITOS

  • Formação em Administração, Economia, Marketing e áreas afins;
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar dados de mercado, vendas e comportamento de consumidores, transformando-os em estratégias de ações;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de layouts criativos para campanhas promocionais.
  • Conhecimento em marketing digital, estratégias promocionais e gestão de ações comerciais;
  • Experiência anterior com análise de dados e ações promocionais, especialmente em empresas da área farmacêutica ou setores relacionados;
  • Domínio avançado de Excel para análise de dados e construção de relatórios e dashboards;
  • Familiaridade com o sistema Winthor (Diferencial).

O QUE BUSCAMOS EM VOCÊ

  • Proatividade e criatividade na resolução de problemas e desenvolvimento de estratégias;
  • Capacidade de liderança e trabalho em equipe;
  • Orientação a resultados, com foco na performance e na melhoria contínua das ações;
  • Comunicativo(a), prestativo(a), resiliente, com forte capacidade analítica e uma mentalidade orientada a resultados.

Company Overview
Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. As a Technical Support Engineer specializing in Microsoft services, you will act as a trusted advisor to customers while serving as a technical escalation point for complex issues related to Docusign’s Microsoft integrations. You will provide exceptional support across APIs, network environments, and web-based workflows, helping customers maximize adoption and performance. You’ll collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, and Support teams to solve problems and advocate for product improvements that enhance customer experience. This role is part of our global Customer Success team and plays a critical role in ensuring service excellence and operational efficiency.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Manager, Technical Support.

  • Provide advanced technical support for Docusign’s Microsoft integrations, including SharePoint, Power Automate, Dynamics, and Logic Apps

  • Utilize tools like Salesforce, Jira, internal admin consoles, and logging systems to track and resolve support issues
  • Identify product defects and suggest improvements to enhance Microsoft-related customer workflows
  • Promote Docusign solutions through consultative dialogue and understanding of support needs
  • Meet or exceed service level goals specific to the Microsoft integration support domain

Remote: Employee is not required to be in or near an office frequently and works from a designated remote work location for the majority of the time.

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

What you bring

Basic

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline
  • 2+ years of experience in SaaS technical support or NOC roles
  • Experience troubleshooting in web-based environments (HTTP, JSON, HTML, CSS, IIS)
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft SharePoint (on-prem and SaaS), Power Automate, Dynamics, and Logic Apps
  • Experience with Windows PowerShell scripting
  • Experience in Microsoft system administration
  • Experience with log analysis tools such as Wireshark, Fiddler, or Charles Proxy

Preferred

  • 1-2+ years as a Support Expert for Docusign or similar technologies
  • Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences
  • Experience supporting embedded signing, On-Demand Signature Service, or Docusign Central
  • Familiarity with Docusign CLM workflows and architecture
  • Mastery of regular expressions, code debugging, and complex data validation
  • Experience with REST and SOAP APIs, SDKs, and authentication (SAML, OAuth)
  • Prior use of Dynatrace or similar monitoring tools
  • Experience with internal logging tools and backend troubleshooting
  • Microsoft certifications or equivalent industry credentials
  • Professional experience in a relevant vertical supported by Docusign
  • Self-motivated and goal-oriented with excellent organizational and time management skills

Life at Docusign

Working here

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

You will feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. title: B2 Licensed Aircraft Engineer
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled and detail-oriented B2 Licensed Aircraft Engineer to join our maintenance team. In this role, you will be responsible for the electrical, electronic, and avionics systems of aircraft. As a B2 Licensed Aircraft Engineer, you will work alongside a dedicated team of engineers and technicians, ensuring that all electrical and avionics systems are maintained to the highest safety and performance standards.

Your responsibilities will include troubleshooting, conducting routine inspections, and performing repairs on aircraft avionics systems such as communication, navigation, and radar systems. This role is essential for ensuring that aircraft are safe and comply with aviation regulations, making it a critical position within the aviation industry.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Perform scheduled and unscheduled maintenance on aircraft avionics and electrical systems.
  • Troubleshoot and repair aircraft electronics, including communication, navigation, radar, and autopilot systems.
  • Conduct pre-flight and post-flight inspections of electrical and avionics systems to ensure airworthiness.
  • Carry out avionics modifications and upgrades in accordance with manufacturer and regulatory guidelines.
  • Read and interpret wiring diagrams, technical manuals, and engineering documents to diagnose issues.
  • Complete maintenance documentation and logbooks accurately, recording all work performed.
  • Collaborate with the flight crew to ensure all avionics systems are functioning properly.
  • Calibrate and test avionics instruments to ensure proper operation.
  • Supervise and guide junior technicians in the completion of their tasks.
  • Ensure all maintenance activities comply with safety and regulatory standards.
  • Liaise with regulatory authorities and participate in audits or inspections as required.
  • Stay updated on new technologies, regulations, and industry best practices in avionics and electrical systems.
Qualifications:
  • Valid EASA Part 66 B2 License (or equivalent recognized by local aviation authorities).
  • Extensive knowledge of aircraft electrical, electronics, and avionics systems, including communication, navigation, and autopilot systems.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in aircraft avionics maintenance or modifications.
  • Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting skills with avionics equipment.
  • Ability to read and interpret complex wiring diagrams, schematics, and technical manuals.
  • Proficiency in using electrical testing equipment, such as multimeters and oscilloscopes.
  • High attention to detail and a commitment to safety.
  • Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment and meet tight deadlines.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • EASA Part 66 B2 License or equivalent qualification (e.g., FAA A&P License with avionics endorsement, CAA B2 License).
  • Aircraft Type Ratings on relevant aircraft models (e.g., Airbus, Boeing, Bombardier, etc.).
  • Human Factors certification.
  • Current EWIS (Electrical Wiring Interconnection System) certificate.
  • Fuel Tank Safety certification (Level 1 and 2 preferred).
  • Updated training on relevant regulations (Part 145, Part M, etc.).
  • Type ratings on multiple aircraft types.
  • Experience with advanced avionics systems, including modern glass cockpit technology (e.g., Garmin, Honeywell, Rockwell Collins).
  • Experience in both line and base maintenance environments.
  • Certification in avionics troubleshooting techniques.

description:
O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 119 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 90.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 13.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

SOBRE O BANCO DE TALENTOS

A Gurilândia é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. O amor e o acolhimento são marcas da escola, semeadas pela Tia Vera desde a sua fundação e a Gurilândia e a Land School se baseiam em quatro pilares - Tradição, Inovação, Excelência Acadêmica e Mentalidade Internacional. Há 60 anos estamos educando gerações em Salvador, e preparando os nossos alunos para os desafios de hoje com uma educação que alia vanguarda e tradição.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de agentes de transformação que sejam capazes de alcançar realização pessoal e profissional com ética e responsabilidade social. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos, que superam desafios diariamente com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Este é um banco de talentos para Professores de Matemática. Se você ama trabalhar com essa disciplina, se comunica de forma clara e é uma pessoa proativa, não deixe de enviar seu currículo!

Como nosso Professor(a) de Matemática, você cumpriria as seguintes atividades:

  • Adquirir conhecimento sobre os programas curriculares utilizados nas séries em que leciona;
  • Trabalhar colaborativamente com outros professores e lideranças da matéria e do segmento, buscando alinhamento e consistência;
  • Planejar as aulas e produzir materiais pedagógicos, levando em conta as individualidades dos alunos;
  • Ministrar aulas da matéria alinhadas com a BNCC e o Material Didático selecionado pela escola (físico ou digital);
  • Utilizar práticas variadas de ensino/aprendizagem, incluindo metodologias ativas, ensino responsivo, avaliação para o aprendizado (Assessment for Learning) e métodos investigativos;
  • Utilizar de forma consistente tecnologias para enriquecer e melhorar o aprendizado;
  • Supervisionar alunos em espaços escolares;
  • Substituir professores no mesmo segmento quando solicitado;
  • Mediar relacionamento entre crianças, famílias e escola;
  • Preparar avaliações e comunicar os resultados;
  • Tabular e analisar dados pedagógicos com o intuito de ajustar ensino e melhorar o aprendizado;
  • Formatar e alimentar com dados nossa plataforma de acompanhamento de avaliações (iSams) em preparação para relatórios para famílias;
  • Participar de reuniões pedagógicas (incluindo COC) e eventos realizados na escola;
  • Garantir a segurança física e emocional dos alunos, e zelar pelo seu crescimento sócio-emocional (safeguarding).

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

Para se inscrever você irá precisar ter:

  • Diploma de Licenciatura em Matemática.

Nossos professores devem ser capazes de/devem ter:

  • Capacidade de trabalhar colaborativamente, em equipe;
  • Paixão pela profissão;
  • Estar sempre em busca de melhorias;
  • Atitude positiva frente a mudanças;
  • Compreensão profunda da matéria lecionada;
  • Estabelecer expectativas claras e esticar metas;
  • Excelente planejamento de aulas e domínio de sala;
  • Habilidade de julgar a efetividade do aprendizado;
  • Comprometimento com o desenvolvimento dos alunos, avaliando os resultados e fornecendo feedback para melhorar seu desempenho;
  • Preocupação e atenção genuína pelos níveis mais altos de bem-estar dos alunos.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais.

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

Descrição da empresa

A SGS é uma Multinacional Suiça, líder mundial em Inspeção, Verificação, Testes e Certificação, somos reconhecidos por nossa qualidade e integridade. Estamos presentes em mais de 140 países, com 99.600 colaboradores no mundo, contamos com 2.650 escritórios e laboratórios. Nosso time no Brasil possui aproximadamente 4.000 colaboradores, distribuídos nas 5 unidades de negócios, sendo elas:

Industries & Environment - Possibilitando infraestrutura, transporte e indústrias mais seguras, sustentáveis e ecológicas. Na SGS, fornecemos a gama mais abrangente do mundo de serviços integrados de inspeção, teste, certificação e consultoria, com tecnologia de ponta e ferramentas digitais. Nossa rede global de especialistas ajuda a indústria a navegar por uma ampla gama de novos padrões, regulamentos e responsabilidades corporativas.

Health & Nutrition – Trabalhamos para ampliar a segurança, qualidade e sustentabilidade dos produtos alimentares, de saúde e bem-estar. Os clientes precisam saber que os alimentos que ingerem, os medicamentos, os produtos cosméticos e de higiene que utilizam são seguros e não os prejudicam. Na SGS, oferecemos a mais ampla gama de soluções de teste, inspeção e certificação para as indústrias de ciência agrícola, alimentos, ciências da saúde e cosméticos e higiene.

Natural Resources – Possibilitando eficiência e sustentabilidade nas indústrias agrícola, de mineração, petróleo, gás e química. Os recursos naturais são essenciais para o desenvolvimento econômico e fundamentais para a vida cotidiana. Nossa rede global de especialistas oferece suporte com terceirização de laboratório, logística de commodities, geoquímica, metalurgia, sustentabilidade e soluções de inteligência de mercado para ajudar a reduzir riscos, tomar decisões informadas e garantir a integridade.

Connectivity & Products – Possibilitando produtos e serviços melhores e mais seguros. À medida que o mundo se torna mais conectado, marcas, fabricantes, varejistas e governos devem garantir a segurança, a qualidade e a conformidade regulatória de seus produtos e serviços. Fornecemos a gama mais abrangente do mundo de serviços de inspeção, teste, certificação e consultoria, com tecnologia de ponta e ferramentas digitais. Nossa rede global de especialistas oferece suporte em todas as etapas – desde o projeto, produção e conformidade regulamentar até a importação e exportação de mercadorias.

Business Assurance – Transformar os negócios e viabilizar o crescimento sustentável aprimorando conhecimento, habilidades e processos com certificação, auditorias de fornecedores, avaliações de sustentabilidade, consultoria e treinamento. Em uma economia cada vez mais globalizada, sua organização deve manter-se atualizada com as complexas obrigações regulatórias, padrões e melhores práticas para reduzir os riscos jurídicos, financeiros e reputacionais. Com a expertise e o conhecimento de nossa equipe, trabalhando com processos e ferramentas avançadas, ajudamos organizações a melhorar resultados, gerenciar riscos, cumprir mudanças regulatórias e adotar melhores práticas, além de capacitar, tanto o profissional autônomo ou in-company, através do SGS Academy.

Valorizamos a inovação, excelência e colaboração em tudo o que fazemos. Respeitamos e apoiamos a diversidade em todas as suas formas, vetando a discriminação contra qualquer candidato a emprego devido à identidade ou expressão de gênero do indivíduo, orientação sexual, deficiência visível e/ou invisível, origem socioeconômica e/ou multicultural, condições de saúde, idade, religião, ou quaisquer características protegidas por lei. Company Description

With over 6,000 employees in more than 20 countries, Statkraft is one of the leaders in hydropower internationally and the largest generator of renewable energy in Europe. The Norwegian group produces hydropower, wind power, solar power, gas-fired power, and provides district heating.

With actions guided by ethics and transparency, the company is headquartered in the city of Florianópolis, Santa Catarina (SC). Currently, it controls 26 renewable generation assets in Brazil. In November 2023, Statkraft signed the purchase of Enerfín, the renewable subsidiary of the Spanish company Elecnor, which includes nine operational wind farms in the states of Rio Grande do Sul and Rio Grande do Norte. Thus, the company became one of the largest wind power generators in Brazil, surpassing the mark of 2.2 GW of installed capacity, including acquisitions, constructions, and operations in the country.

CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil ( é uma organização brasileira, sem fins lucrativos, constituída em 2007, para contribuir na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas que vivem em situações de vulnerabilidade. É uma organização local vinculada ao contexto internacional, por meio da parceria com a Fundação AVSI, ONG de origem italiana que atua no Brasil desde os anos 80 e que estimulou a criação da AVSI Brasil. Sua missão é tornar as pessoas, em situações de vulnerabilidade ou emergência humanitária, protagonistas do próprio desenvolvimento, da sua família e comunidade, por meio de projetos sociais em diferentes áreas.

No âmbito da parceria com a Enel Distribuição São Paulo e Ceará, a AVSI Brasil atuará a partir de 2025 na execução e formatação sistemática do PROGRAMA ECOENEL - Troca de resíduos por bônus na conta de energia. Esta iniciativa considera a educação ambiental, por meio da reciclagem, como elemento fundamentador da construção de uma sociedade com maior responsabilidade social e ambiental.

Primary Interface between Markets/Sales, Strategic Product Management, and Operations for ASU products:

  • Primary day-to-day interface with account managers and regional Markets leadership on understanding changes in customer demand that will affect supply network configuration.

  • Support Tonnage account managers on liquid back-up or supplemental concerns (volume availability and costing).

Tactical Supply Chain Planning and Optimization:

  • Assigns plant production rates, operating modes and inventory targets in collaboration with Remote Operating Center engineers and Energy Procurement team to minimize overall product costs. This includes day-of plant turndowns/shutdowns to meet power reduction obligations and minimize/avoid peak power costs.
  • Responsible for coordinating with scheduling teams on inventory vs alternate sourcing needs to minimize impact to customers.
  • Ensures all mid- and long-term purchase agreements are utilized based on lowest total incremental costs.
  • Responsible for development, use and compliance to proprietary network optimization systems (TACT), including quality of inputs and adherence to outputs.
  • Execute supply reviews with Supply field regions and develop operational plans for Sales and Operations Planning. Sets transport resource levels required to fulfill plan while minimizing assets and costs.

Operative Supply Chain Response:

  • Responsible for ensuring sufficient inventory for all pipeline demand (gaseous) and internal plant uses through inventory planning via plant mode changes, liquid product transfers between storage tanks, liquid imports (as required) and/or coordinating deliveries from third parties.
  • Plan, track and own the outage process for ASU. Includes developing plans, forecasting and tracking costs, and providing timely communication on the status of the network during planned and unplanned outages.

Systems Usage & Maintenance:

  • Parcview, J5, Telemetry
  • TACT, Optimizer and potential new, future network optimization tools
  • Sales and Operations Planning including Demand Planning tools
  • SAP and GOLD
  • SAP Analytics Cloud for data visualization

Others:

  • Supervises ASU logistics analyst who is responsible for immediate term coordination of supply network, managing finished product inventories and take-or-pays and FOB (pickup) customers.
  • Responsible for developing key operational assumptions and associated costs for the annual budgeting process and ongoing reforecasts, including purchases, rail shipments, planned outage (dislocation) costs.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in logistics, supply chain, business or engineering.
  • Minimum of 7 years experience in industrial gases or related process industry with supply chain management experience.
  • C.P., M.B.A. and six sigma certifications are a plus.

Required key skills:

  • Strong strategic and tactical thinking are required to analyze and manage a dynamic national network.
  • Must have strong Microsoft Office skills, especially in Excel, Power Point and Word.
  • SAP skills are required.

description:
About Us

We are an innovative iGaming company offering a comprehensive suite of crypto-focused products, including sportsbook and casino experiences. By combining cutting-edge technology with a deep understanding of the crypto space, we aim to revolutionise the betting and gaming experience for a global audience.

Our mission is to create the most effortless and accessible betting and gaming entertainment experience, delivering innovation and personalisation at every touchpoint.

Our vision is to become a leading player in the betting industry by combining seamless user experiences with groundbreaking personalisation and community-driven engagement.

Whether it’s through competitive sportsbook offerings or immersive casino gameplay, we are dedicated to creating a unique and engaging platform. Join us in shaping the future of crypto iGaming.

Purpose of the Role

We’re looking for a dedicated Frontend Engineer to craft engaging, high-performance, mobile-first web experiences for our next-generation iGaming product. You’ll collaborate closely with UX designers and cross-functional teams to bring user-centric designs to life, delivering high-performance, friction-less experiences across mobile and desktop.

Role and Responsibilities

  • Feature Development : Build and maintain player-facing features using TypeScript, React, and Storybook.
  • UX Collaboration : Work hand-in-hand with UX designers to translate wireframes and prototypes into polished, responsive interfaces.
  • Reusable Components : Develop and document reusable UI components and style guidelines, ensuring design consistency and maintainability.
  • Performance & Optimization : Implement best practices for responsive design, page load speed, and overall frontend performance.
  • Quality Assurance : Write clean, testable code, participate in code reviews, and maintain robust testing strategies.
  • Cross-Team Coordination : Coordinate with backend, product, and QA teams to align on feature requirements, timelines, and best practices.

Work Experience and Skills

Essential Experience

  • 5+ years of hands-on frontend development, building mobile-first, customer-facing progressive web applications (PWA).
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript, React, higher-level frameworks like Next.js or React Router, and component libraries like Storybook.
  • Comfortable working with design tools (Figma, Sketch, etc.) and implementing shared design systems.
  • Excellent communication skills and a proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.
  • Adept at troubleshooting and debugging complex issues across all frontend systems.

Essential Skills

  • iGaming Expertise : Familiarity with online gaming interfaces, mechanics, or industry-specific constraints.
  • Accessibility : Experience with modern design principles and accessibility standards.
  • Performance Tuning : Hands-on experience with performance profiling and frontend optimization techniques.
  • Passion for Gaming : Genuine interest in creating engaging and interactive user experiences for gaming audiences.

Personal Qualities and Behavioral Traits

Essential Qualities and Behaviours:

  • Self-starter with a proactive mindset and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, remote environment.
  • Strong communicator, able to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams across different time zones.
  • High level of accountability and ownership over delivered features and system stability.
  • Passionate about delivering world-class user experiences through robust backend solutions.
  • Analytical thinker with a pragmatic approach to problem-solving.

Desirable Qualities and Behaviours:

  • Interest in blockchain, crypto technologies, and their application in gaming.
  • Enthusiastic about the gaming industry, particularly within the casino and sports betting sectors.
  • Open to experimenting with new technologies and approaches to stay at the cutting edge of innovation.
  • Mentor mindset with a desire to help others develop their skills.

title: Senior Azure DevOps Engineer
description:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.


What we are looking for
  • 7+ years of experience in DevOps, with 5+ years in Azure environments
  • Expertise in Azure infrastructure, networking, and security, including VNets, Front Door, WAF, Firewalls (Premium + IDPS), VPN, DNS, AD, App Service, Container Apps, Function Apps, Event Hub, Defender, and Sentinel
  • Preferred experience administering Azure AD B2C, with deep understanding of identity and authentication security best practices
  • Strong experience with Terraform (IaC), managing scalable and resilient cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience managing CI/CD pipelines with Azure Pipelines, incorporating security and performance testing
  • Expertise in Application Performance Monitoring (APM) with Datadog strongly preferred, including real-time alerting and troubleshooting
  • Familiarity with Hub-and-Spoke network architecture and cloud security principles
  • Strong database administration experience with Azure SQL Server, including cloud-based backup, replication, and high-availability strategies. Experience with the Hyperscale service tier is a strong plus.
  • Experience with disaster recovery, incident management, and high-availability architectures
  • Deep understanding of DevSecOps principles, including security compliance, role-based access control, and vulnerability management
  • Proficiency in Git and GitHub for version control and workflow automation
  • Experience in optimizing cloud costs (FinOps) and monitoring usage trends.
  • Ability to thrive in a detail-oriented, fast-paced remote work environment, handling multiple projects simultaneously
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience supporting a remote team
  • Azure and/or Security certification(s) a plus
Responsibilities
  • Manage and optimize Azure infrastructure, networking, security, and identity management, ensuring compliance with SOC 2 and industry best practices
  • Ensure customer-facing systems maintain high availability and rapid incident response, including automated failover and disaster recovery strategies
  • Maintain and enhance Azure Pipelines for seamless CI/CD workflows, integrating automated security, unit, integration, and end-to-end testing
  • Implement and manage Terraform for infrastructure automation
  • Own the Datadog APM ecosystem, implementing best practices for monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and compliance
  • Implement DevSecOps practices, including security scanning, role-based access controls (RBAC), and proactive threat mitigation using Azure Defender and Sentinel
  • Continuously monitor Azure cost trends, implementing FinOps strategies to optimize cloud expenses while maintaining performance and security
  • Administer and enhance Azure AD B2C, ensuring secure authentication and identity management
  • Develop and maintain incident response playbooks and disaster recovery strategies, ensuring data integrity and business continuity
  • Work closely with Engineering and Security teams, documenting best practices, infrastructure changes, and operational procedures
Company Benefits
  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

At Air Products, our purpose is to bring people together to reimagine what’s possible, collaborate and innovate solutions to the world’s most significant energy and environmental sustainability challenges. Grow with us as we embark on building tomorrow together by being the safest, most diverse and most profitable industrial gas company in the world.
Reimagine What’s Possible
Rotoflow is a full-service turbomachinery OEM - providing a wide range of new equipment solutions and aftermarket services to our customers globally. For over 75 years, Rotoflow has designed and manufactured both standard and custom-engineered cryogenic and warm gas centrifugal turbomachinery used in market segments such as industrial gases, petrochemicals, and hydrocarbons. Products include compressor loaded turbo-expanders, generator-loaded power recovery expanders, and low-cost dissipative expanders. We offer new equipment designs, rerates, upgrades and repair along with field services, engineering evaluations, reliability, troubleshooting, training, remote diagnostics/data monitoring, shop services, and new equipment replacements for all types of centrifugal and reciprocating equipment. Our customers are served globally through regional service centers supported by both regional and centralized execution teams.
Gardner Cryogenics designs and manufactures high-performance, highly reliable, long-lasting storage tanks used to transport hydrogen and helium molecules around the globe. With more than six decades of experience, Gardner provides customers with industry-leading technology that enables them to cost-effectively move and store molecules with near zero loss. The unique technology developed by Gardner provides the lowest heat-leak for the highest yield when transporting, storing, and transferring helium and hydrogen.
We are seeking a results-oriented Planning and Scheduling Team Manager for our Gardner Cryogenics and Rotoflow manufacturing facilities, within the Lehigh Valley, PA. This position will be responsible for managing planning and scheduling team and overseeing the entire process from new order intake through delivery of contract, including aggregating information for resource planning, reporting of on-time delivery metrics, and helping to drive process improvements in the speed of execution, process efficiency and fulfilment of orders. This position interfaces closely with Sales and Proposals, Manufacturing, Project Management, Engineering, Procurement and Supply Chain to ensure execution and manufacturing dates are being met. This position will be located in Bethlehem, Pennsylvania and will split time between the Rotoflow and Gardner facilities.
What's In It For You
At Air Products we foster a culture of inclusion where every voice is heard, and everyone feels they belong and matter. Additionally, we offer competitive pay and great benefits for our employees. Check out some of our benefits below!

  • Affordable Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance (day 1 of employment)
  • 401k with 100% vested company core and match
  • Paid Vacation, holidays + sick time
  • Paid Parental leave (Up to 8 weeks)
  • Backup Child and Adult Care benefit

  • Flexible spending accounts (medical, dependent daycare)

  • Legal Plan & Identity theft coverage
  • EAP (Employee Assistance Program)
  • Many more supplemental benefits available
Key Job Responsibilities
  • Leading and developing the team of planners and schedulers across Gardner and Rotoflow,
  • Acting as a mentor, guide, and decision maker for the team to enable peak performance and remove barriers to progress,
  • Conducting performance evaluations and direct day-to-day management of team members,
  • Setting overarching goals, objectives, and development plans for the team and team members aligned with leadership cascaded goals,
  • Driving the team to efficiently and effectively plan and schedule activities aligned with Project Management milestones and delivery schedules,
  • Owning and driving enhancement and improving accuracy of the Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) process and reporting out to the Leadership Team,
  • Translating sales opportunity pipeline into workforce and facility demand and capacity planning and scheduling (S&OP),
  • Working closely with Sales and Proposals to anticipate order timing and align proposal schedules and deliveries with current workload, supplier loading and availability, and facility capacity to ensure appropriate customer deliveries are achievable,
  • Setting priorities, finding solutions, and collaborating with all disciplines within the business to enable the faithful execution of work,
  • Driving the optimization of plans and schedules based on inputs (part availability, resource availability, work center availability, etc.) to accommodate unplanned or unforeseen circumstances such as customer emergencies,
  • Developing a world class planning and scheduling work processes, systems, and tools to enable efficient and effective execution of all aspects of work aligned with the business growth goals,
  • Assessing and resolving limitations, gaps, constraints, bottlenecks, delays, and other unplanned barriers impacting engineering and manufacturing,
  • Leading production meetings,
  • Developing and owning key performance indicators for planning and scheduling and reporting out to the Leadership Team,
Minimum Hiring Requirements
  • B.S. in a technical discipline preferred. Experience considered in lieu of a technical degree.
  • Minimum 5 years of planning and scheduling experience with discrete equipment manufacturing or similar.
  • Prior leadership experience leading a team of direct reports.
  • Exemplify a passion for winning and ability to motivate teams.
  • Working knowledge of SAP Production Planning module preferred.
  • Certifications such as PPM, APICS, ASM, or related are a strong plus.
  • Experience with MS Office Suite, (Excel, Word, Project, Outlook, PowerPoint) required.
  • Broad strategic thinker, with a clear vision and direction to improve business performance.
  • Proven track record for planning and scheduling process improvement and results.
  • Advanced problem-solving skills. Identify and recommend alternative solutions and translate complex concepts into simplified and understandable examples.
  • Detail, goal, and results oriented, organized, creative, self-motivated, collaborative, and customer focused.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills (written, verbal and presentation).
  • Highly effective communication, collaboration, conflict management, performance management, data driven and analytical approach.
  • Excellent time management skills and ability to work independently on multiple concurrent projects or tasks and collaboratively with engineers, technicians, and suppliers in shop, office, and field environments.
  • High energy, desire to learn new skills, and desire to understand the specifics of the processes and inter-related steps that are required to fulfil a variety of orders, from design, engineering, procurement, and manufacturing.
  • Ability to create an environment of trust and consistently exhibit a positive attitude.

Optimize global logistics network efficiency and effectiveness through capacity planning, network modeling, and warehouse engineering. This role analyzes infrastructure, mid- and long-term supply plans, and designs agile, cost-effective networks to accommodate growth while maximizing service levels.

Your Key Responsibilities Include:

  1. Conduct detailed analysis of current logistics capacity, including warehouse space, transportation routes, and distribution centers, to identify optimization opportunities. Project mid- and long-term capacity requirements. Monitor KPIs related to logistics capacity and network performance.

  7. Regularly review and audit logistics capacity and network performance to ensure alignment with business needs.
  8. Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in logistics capacity planning, network modeling, and warehouse design.
  9. Provide guidance and support to logistics team members on capacity planning tools, processes, and methodologies.

Required Experience and Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Supply Chain Management, Statistics, or equivalent experience.
  • Fluent or advanced proficiency in English.
  • Logistics Experience:

  • Network Modeling:

  • Team Collaboration and Interpersonal Skills:

HABILIDADES

Esta rede é direcionada a pessoas plenos e sêniores que buscam atuar como Investor na XP Inc na região de Belo Horizonte. Temos vagas previstas para serem abertas em 2024 com diversas senioridades na estrutura. Caso seu perfil faça sentido para alguma destas vagas , entraremos em contato, convidando para avançar no processo seletivo.

Como Investor do time de Estratégia XP , você ficará responsável por trabalhar o asset allocation dos clientes de forma sofisticada, garantindo o enquadramento dos portfólios, de acordo com o suitability de cada cliente.

O Investor ocupa a posição de referência técnica para o segmento e, além de garantir a qualidade na alocação dos clientes, atua sendo interface direta com as áreas de negócio da companhia, pensando estrategicamente quais ativos devem ser trabalhados e quais perfis de cliente têm maior propensão para determinada oferta. Geram insumos comerciais para todo o time, através de treinamentos, dados, materiais, etc.

  • Atender os principais clientes da XP, em conjunto com o Banker do cliente;
  • Ser referência técnica sobre produtos, planejamento financeiro e asset allocation no segmento;
  • Identificar as melhores oportunidades de investimentos, garantindo assertividade comercial;
  • Construir e disseminar as melhores práticas de investimentos entre os assessores;
  • Realizar consultoria de investimentos para garantir excelência no atendimento e monitorar os indicadores de qualidade;

  • Presencial em Belo Horizonte e proximidades.

  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: preferencialmente presencial para frentes de negócio, predominantemente remoto para times de tecnologia e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. title: Associate Director, Sales
description:
Join to apply for the Associate Director, Sales role at Shure Incorporated .

We are seeking a dynamic, experienced Associate Director, Sales to lead Shure’s sales strategy across South America, overseeing the Brazil-based Channel Marketing and Customer Experience teams serving Latin America. The role involves driving revenue growth through channel partnerships, developing go-to-market strategies, strengthening partner engagement, and aligning with Shure’s brand and business objectives. It also includes shaping long-term goals, uncovering new opportunities, and enhancing the end-user experience.

If you have a strong background in sales and marketing leadership, a deep understanding of the Latin American channel ecosystem, and a proven ability to build collaborative relationships that drive customer success, apply now!

Fluency in English, Spanish, and Portuguese is required. This role is based in São Paulo, Brazil.

Responsibilities

  1. Lead the South America sales organization, managing sales performance, growth targets, and margin improvements. Develop and implement strategic plans to exceed sales targets across all product lines.
  2. Provide leadership to the Sales, Channel Marketing, and Customer Experience teams, ensuring alignment, accountability, and high performance. Set goals, coach team members, and foster a culture of innovation and professional growth.
  3. Manage strategic channel accounts, focusing on growth, value creation, and customer journey improvements. Build long-term relationships with top partners and ensure strategic alignment.
  4. Oversee regional channel marketing and customer engagement initiatives in collaboration with the Brazil-based team supporting Latin America. Ensure programs are effective and aligned with sales objectives, contributing to partner enablement and customer success.
  5. Develop and execute regional channel sales plans with cross-functional teams, identifying gaps and opportunities to increase market penetration and partner performance.
  6. Support regional promotions, product launches, events, and training programs in collaboration with internal teams like product marketing, global accounts, and operations.
  7. Represent the voice of Latin American channel partners internally, providing strategic input on global and regional initiatives. Lead regional projects supporting business transformation.
  8. Manage budgeting and forecasting for regional teams, ensuring alignment with business goals and responsible financial management.
  9. Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related field.
  • 10–12 years of experience in sales and/or channel leadership.
  • 7+ years managing teams and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Knowledge of the professional audio or AV industry is preferred.
  • Experience working with Latin American channel ecosystems.
  • Ability to manage complexity, execute strategies, and lead in a matrix organization.
  • Proficiency in Salesforce or similar CRM tools.
  • Strong executive presence and communication skills.
  • Ability to inspire and motivate diverse teams.
  • Willingness to travel up to 75%.
  • Languages: Fluency in English, Spanish, and Portuguese.

Who We Are

Shure’s mission is to be the most trusted audio brand worldwide. Founded in 1925, we are a leading manufacturer of audio equipment, known for quality, reliability, and durability. We engineer microphones, headphones, wireless systems, and more. We foster an inclusive culture, offering flexible work arrangements and opportunities for all.

Headquartered in the United States, we have over 35 regional offices, engineering hubs, and manufacturing facilities across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia.

The Mix Matters

If you don’t meet every requirement but are excited about this role and share our values, we encourage you to apply. We are committed to an inclusive, diverse, equitable, and accessible workplace.

What You'll Need To Bring...

title: Gerente de Vendas | Bombas e Rodovias
description:
Você conhece a Sany do Brasil? Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração.

Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias. Em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister, formando o maior líder mundial na área de equipamentos para concreto.

Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países. No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany começou em 2007, inicialmente como importador de equipamentos. Em 2011, consolidou sua presença no país com investimentos de aproximadamente US$ 200 milhões. Nesse mesmo ano, inaugurou sua primeira unidade fabril em São José dos Campos, SP, com 30 mil m², para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão, no regime CKD (Completely Knock-Down). Em 2012, recebeu a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008 pela Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini, garantindo rigorosos processos de qualidade e segurança.

Em 2013, iniciou a montagem de guindastes RT (rough terrain) e rolos compactadores em sua unidade de fabricação. No final de 2017, inaugurou instalações em Jacareí/SP. A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias para oferecer produtos e serviços de pós-venda em todo o Brasil.

Como nosso Gerente de Vendas, você irá:

  • Desenvolver e implementar o plano estratégico de vendas para o portfólio de Bombas e Rodovias;
  • Gerenciar o funil de vendas, desde a prospecção até o fechamento de contratos, garantindo a satisfação do cliente;
  • Identificar oportunidades de mercado e novas demandas, analisando concorrência, tendências e potencial de clientes;
  • Construir e manter relacionamentos com stakeholders do setor;
  • Realizar visitas técnicas e comerciais, apresentações de produtos e negociações;
  • Colaborar com as áreas de engenharia, pós-vendas e operações para garantir soluções técnicas adequadas e cumprimento de prazos;
  • Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho da área comercial (KPIs), como volume de vendas, margem, rentabilidade e forecast;

  12. Realizar o acompanhamento e treinamento de colaboradores recém-admitidos, com exercício de mesma função assistencial;
  13. Garantir as ações de preventiva e corretiva dos equipamentos da unidade, preservando o funcionamento adequado conforme políticas institucionais;
  14. Exercer as atividades baseado nos protocolos institucionais na busca da prevenção e controle sistemático de danos a pacientes durante a assistência de saúde através do cumprimento das metas de segurança do paciente;

Sobre a Associação Congregação de Santa Catarina (ACSC)

Há 120 anos no Brasil, a ACSC é responsável pela administração de 19 entidades com atuação social, em saúde e educação, que formam a Rede Santa Catarina. Com um modelo de gestão em que o superávit gerado é aplicado em nossas obras a fim de executar dignamente nossas atividades, a instituição acolhe e cuida do ser humano em todo o ciclo da vida. Ao todo são cerca de 10,5 mil colaboradores distribuídos em diversas instituições de saúde, mantendo inúmeros estabelecimentos de ensino e acolhendo crianças, adultos e idosos em espaços assistenciais, com atendimento humanizado e serviços de qualidade para milhares de pessoas em seis Estados brasileiros (Espírito Santo, Goiás, Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, Santa Catarina e São Paulo).

Acolher e cuidar do ser humano durante todo o ciclo da vida.

VISÃO

Ser referência de entidade filantrópica reconhecida pela sociedade, demonstrando amor às pessoas por meio de nossos atos.

VALORES

Preservação da vida, Humanização, Dignidade, Transparência e Sustentabilidade.

Aqui, você terá a chance de aplicar suas habilidades em engenharia de dados para criar soluções robustas e de alta performance.

A evolução constante das necessidades do negócio será um estímulo para sua criatividade e inovação. Sua capacidade de adaptar e atualizar a arquitetura de dados para atender às novas demandas, tecnologias e fontes de dados será essencial, garantindo que a empresa esteja sempre à frente das tendências e preparada para o futuro.

Em resumo, a missão na área de dados será desafiadora, mas cheia de oportunidades de crescimento e impacto. Você terá a chance de moldar a arquitetura de dados de forma estratégica, promovendo eficiência, inovação e segurança, e tornando-se uma peça chave para o sucesso da organização. Se você busca um ambiente dinâmico, em constante evolução e com um grande potencial de impacto, essa é a oportunidade ideal para alavancar sua carreira na área de dados.

Na MadeiraMadeira acreditamos que a base para uma operação eficiente, escalável e orientada a dados é uma arquitetura sólida e moderna. O Arquiteto de Dados será responsável por desenhar, implementar e evoluir uma arquitetura de dados que suporte os desafios de um varejo digital dinâmico e em constante crescimento.

Seu papel será garantir que os dados estejam disponíveis, confiáveis e acessíveis para as áreas de negócio, produto e operações. O objetivo final é habilitar decisões mais rápidas e assertivas, reduzir perdas operacionais e impulsionar métricas críticas, como aumento do GMV (Gross Merchandise Value) e redução de custos logísticos.

Isso inclui ferramentas de processamento e orquestração de dados para garantir fluxos de dados automatizados e resilientes. Tecnologias de armazenamento e análise são essenciais para a construção de data lakes e warehouses performáticos. Por fim, o entendimento de frameworks de segurança e compliance, como ISO 27001 , LGPD , e GDPR , é fundamental para mitigar riscos e garantir a conformidade regulatória.

  • Contato ativo com os maiores clientes de renda variável da XP para acompanhamento de posição e atualização de cenário de mercado;
  • Atuar como referência técnica para clientes e assessores no universo de renda variável.

O que buscamos

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Unreal projects have been leading the pack of real-time entertainment with our constantly growing team of engineering experts. We’re always improving on the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

description:
XP Future 2025 | Transição de Carreira - Espírito Santo

Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra, determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

  • Foco no cliente: Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
  • Sonho grande: Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta: Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

Tem perfil comercial, busca transição de carreira e quer fazer parte de um time de alta performance?

Conheça o XP FUTURE , uma iniciativa disruptiva para profissionais com alto skill comercial e que desejam se tornar assessores de investimentos.

Essa é uma oportunidade para profissionais que estão em busca de uma transição de carreira e possuem experiência comercial para migrarem para o mercado financeiro.

Na XP Inc. você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de vendas, prospecção de clientes, aprofundamento nos produtos de investimentos e, principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira para que você se torne um profissional comercial de sucesso na corretora, e tire a certificação CPA-20 para se tornar um assessor referência no mercado!

Estaremos presencialmente no Espírito Santo para nosso processo seletivo e expandir ainda mais nosso time!

Se você já possui experiência comercial em outros segmentos e deseja fazer uma transição de carreira para o mercado financeiro, conheça os pré-requisitos para iniciar em nosso Programa de Formação XP Future:

  • Graduação superior completa;
  • Experiência comercial (diferencial como Hunter - prospecção de novos negócios);
  • Curiosidade sobre o mundo dos investimentos;
  • Interesse por realizar uma transição de carreira;
  • Conhecimento básico sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros).
  • Estar atuando em outros segmentos de mercado (Meios de pagamentos, adquirência, bebidas, fintechs, etc);
  • Não ser um Assessor de Investimentos ou Agente Autônomo (AAI)

Diferenciais, mas não eliminatórios:

  • Certificação CPA-20.

Principais desafios da cadeira:

  • Prospecção de novos negócios - poder de originação/novos clientes;
  • Organização para trabalhar diversas frentes em curto período de tempo;
  • Forte poder de persuasão;
  • Empatia e visão de longo prazo;
  • Gestão de carteiras e grandes contas - Pessoa Física e Pessoa Jurídica.

Obs: Contratação CLT

Sobre as etapas do processo seletivo - XP Future 2025 - Espírito Santo

  • Realização da etapa de testes - Fit cultural e PI (Obrigatórios)
  • Bate papo com o time de Expansão;
  • Processo seletivo presencial na cidade;
  • As pessoas candidatas aprovadas em processo seletivo serão admitidas no regime CLT e vão atuar na área do B2C;
  • Após início na XP Inc., os assessores contarão com capacitação teórica, cursos preparatórios e treinamentos para as certificações - CPA-20.

Por fim, abaixo segue o vídeo sobre o Fator XP Vitória ! Para você se reconhecer cada vez mais no nosso propósito como empresa e cultura:

“Se te oferecem um lugar em um foguete, não pergunte qual é o assento, apenas embarque.”

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura.   • Evoluir e aprimorar a cobertura e efetividade dos controles de proteção de dados durante o uso, trânsito e repouso, objetivando mitigar riscos de violações de dados.
  • Mapear e mitigar riscos relacionados a dados, implementando estratégias para garantir a conformidade legal e regulatória e a proteção contínua das informações.
  • Auxiliar as equipes técnicas em investigações e respostas a incidentes de segurança, em conformidade com leis e regulações e políticas e normas internas.
  • Estabelecer métricas estratégicas de desempenho, cobertura de riscos e conformidade regulatória, fornecendo insights sobre a efetividade dos controles.
  • Apoiar a equipe de conscientização no desenvolvimento de programas internos de treinamento focado nas melhores práticas de privacidade e proteção de dados.
  • Ser referência técnica da área em assuntos sobre privacidade e proteção de dados, provendo liderança técnica com o time e auxiliando profissionais mais juniores.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que o #TimeCielo espera de você?

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Tecnologia da Informação, Análise de Sistemas, Ciência da Computação e Processamento de Dados.
  • Sólida experiência em programas de governança de dados, contemplando toda a gestão dos dados durante seu ciclo de vida, desde a coleta e uso até o descarte.
  • Experiência em processos de descoberta (data discovery), mapeamento e classificação de informações, em conjunto com as áreas técnicas e de negócio.
  • Capacidade de desenvolver e implementar estratégias de proteção de dados alinhadas com as equipes técnicas, incluindo a definição e escopo de cobertura.
  • Experiência em tecnologias de postura de segurança de dados (DSPM) com foco na análise de vulnerabilidades e ameaças e riscos de não conformidade regulatória.
  • Experiência na elaboração e análise de métricas e indicadores de risco e desempenho, assegurando visibilidade e conformidade com leis e regulações.
  • Experiência com legislação de proteção de dados (LGPD) e frameworks de governança e segurança como DMBOK, PCI DSS, NIST, CIS, ISO 27001 e ISO 27701.
  • Experiência em metodologias ágeis e ferramentas de governança de dados.
  • Perfil resolutivo, proativo e excelente capacidade de trabalhar em equipe.

title: Junior In-Play Trader
description:
Kaizen Gaming, the team powering Betano, is one of the biggest GameTech companies in the world, operating in 19 markets.We always aim to leverage cutting-edge technology, providing the best experience to our millions of customers who trust us for their entertainment.

We are a diverse team of more than 2.700 Kaizeners, from 40+ nationalities spreading across 3 continents. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of race, gender, religion, sexual orientation,or age.

Our #oneteam is proud to be among the Best Workplaces in Europe and certified Great Place to Work across our offices. Here, there’ll be no average day for you. Ready to Press Play on Potential?

Let's start with the role

This role is an opportunity to learn how the odds evolve during a game. The In-play Trading team is responsible for covering all live in-play events and plays a crucial role in shaping our customer experience.

An In-play trader manages events from a wide range of sports, including football, basketball, tennis but also general sports such as volleyball, ice-hockey, beach volleyball etc. They even offer special markets in many of them, surpassing those by other operators. This position demands concentration and observation, combined with a mathematical background, in order to ensure a seamless and enjoyable experience for our users.

The role requires a flexible working schedule to cover the busy sporting calendar (weekends, evenings etc.)

As an In Play Trader you will:

  • Monitor real - time sports events and perform live trading;
  • Supervise and adjust data with the aim of providing precise and competitive live odds;
  • Provide accurate and rapid resulting for any event of a variety of sports;
  • Use both external providers and in-house odds to optimize/customize our offerings and performance;
  • Evaluate events according to their potential demand, to offer the widest and the most competitive offer market wise;.
  • Continuously monitor bet placements, assess live events risks and take appropriate measures to manage and mitigate risks;
  • Ensure that customers have access to the most up-to-date and competitive odds, enhancing the overall betting experience;
  • Maintain effective communication within the trading team and with external stakeholders to ensure a unified and coordinated approach.

What you'll bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g statistics, mathematics,finance)
  • Strong interest in sports with a good understanding of various sports and betting markets;
  • Proven analytical and mathematical skills;
  • Betting/sportsbook playing experience/activity;
  • Be able to make quick, well-informed decisions and work within tight deadlines;
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills;
  • Multitasking abilities and PC literacy;
  • Fluency in English;
  • Willingness to work flexible hours in line with the business and sports calendar requirements.

description:
Join to apply for the Senior Staff Software Engineer, CloudKitchens - São Paulo role at CloudKitchens

22 hours ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Senior Staff Software Engineer, CloudKitchens - São Paulo role at CloudKitchens

Who We Are
CloudKitchens helps restaurateurs around the world succeed in online food delivery - our goal is to make food more affordable, higher quality and convenient for everyone.

Who We Are
CloudKitchens helps restaurateurs around the world succeed in online food delivery - our goal is to make food more affordable, higher quality and convenient for everyone.
We take underutilized properties and transform them into smart kitchens so they can better serve restaurateurs, customers and the neighborhoods they’re in. Every time we launch a new facility we create jobs in that neighborhood, and we’re proud to provide a wide range of cuisines and options for healthy food at an affordable price.
We're changing the game for restaurateurs whether they’re entrepreneurs opening their first restaurant all the way through to your favorite global quick-service restaurant chains.
What You’ll Do

  • Develop clean, efficient, and maintainable code to implement integrations
  • Provide ongoing maintenance, support, and enhancements to existing systems and platforms
  • Design, develop, and maintain APIs that enable seamless communication between internal and external services.
  • Design scalable, reliable, fault-tolerant architectural systems
  • Collaborate and prioritize with cross functional stakeholders, both internal and external
What We’re Looking For
  • 6+ years of proven domain experience as a software engineer.
  • Conversational English, since you’ll be reporting and communicating with global teams in your day-to-day work.
  • Working knowledge of highly distributed systems.
  • Collaborate with leaders to create a center of engineering excellence for Global Integrations and Brazil Engineering.
  • Help teams establish technical understanding and trust needed to succeed and execute on ambitious goals in Integrations
  • Mentor and develop team members on technical and non-technical skills to create a high functioning team
Why join us
 Growing market: You’ll be focused on an $80 billion market that’s projected to reach at least $500 billion by 2030 in the US alone. Changing the restaurant industry: You’ll be part of a team that helps restaurants succeed in online food delivery. Collaborative environment: You will receive support and guidance from experienced colleagues and managers, helping you to learn, grow and achieve your goals, and you’ll work closely with other teams to ensure our customer’s success.
What Else You Need To Know
This role is based in our Sao Paulo location. We believe that people do their best work when they are together. As a company, we’re in the marketplace of ideas and innovation. title: Senior Product Manager - Data and Analytics
description:
Job Description

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Possible.

You will have the opportunity to make a big impact on our business performance as you support the data strategy and lead the development of custom models/algorithms. Working in close partnership with the business leadership team, you will manage the vision and agenda for business analytics in your area of responsibility.

How you will contribute

  1. Drive the vision and delivery of data-driven products for Mondelez finance following established product management practices.

  2. Prioritize development items according to deadlines, business context, and technical needs.

  3. Advocate for and manage funding, including budgeting, headcount needs, and other costs.

  4. Partner with engineering teams to move finance data products to AI-readiness.

  5. Identify opportunities for efficiency, automation, resilience, and innovation in Mondelez’s data landscape.

  6. Bridge conversations between finance business stakeholders and development teams, leveraging knowledge of both Mondelez business domains and technical expertise.

  7. Think strategically, connecting stakeholder use cases to technology solutions and considering the end-to-end experience.

  8. Deeply understand stakeholder needs, product analytics, and industry innovation to drive the product vision and strategy, maximizing business and customer impact.

What you will bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in:

  • HIGHLY ORGANIZED and able to manage competing priorities across stakeholders.

  • LEADERSHIP SKILLS including a natural ability to make things happen while proactively managing ambiguity, complexity, and interdependencies in an organized and structured way.

  • DESIGN and data visualization experience with Tableau or Power BI.

  • BUSINESS ACUMEN and strong working knowledge of corporate finance.

  • GROWTH/DIGITAL MINDSET and the ability to identify and execute opportunities leveraging technology to improve operational efficiency and effectiveness.

  • CLOUD EXPERIENCE with data solutions in AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

  • TECHNICAL EXPERTISE in data and analytics, including data warehousing, SQL, machine learning, and familiarity with modern AI techniques.

  • EXPERIENCE with financial systems such as SAP, SAC, and Hyperion is a plus.

  • INTEGRITY and sound judgment in all decisions and interactions, aligned with our values, policies, and external regulations.

More about this role

We recognize our role as transformation agents to generate positive change, prioritizing diversity, equity, and inclusion. We aim to break stereotypes and barriers to ensure societal representation within our company. Our Diversity Committee operates on four fronts: People with disabilities (PCD), Ethnic-Racial, Women, and LGBTQIAP+, and we are part of MOVER – Movimento pela Equidade Racial.

What you need to know about this position:

As Senior Product Manager for Financial Data & Analytics, you will oversee the development and execution of our financial data products roadmap. Using a mix of technical knowledge and business acumen, you will help Mondelez’s Finance organization build data and analytics products aimed at an AI-ready future. Your products will serve decision-makers at the highest levels, improving measurement and insight through Mondelez’s data. As demand for data and insights grows within Mondelez, your contribution will foster the delivery of timely, relevant, and accurate insights to teams that need them.

What extra ingredients you will bring:

Preferred Experience:

  • Management consulting experience is a plus.
  • Experience in financial services, fintech, or corporate finance departments.
  • Experience with GenAI applications and LLMs.

Travel requirements:

  • Limited travel up to 20% of the time.

Mondelez International values the well-being of our people and offers flexible work arrangements, including hybrid models with remote work options on certain days.

No relocation support is available.

Business Unit Summary

Mondelez Brasil is the company's fourth-largest operation worldwide, with approximately 7,500 employees. We produce, sell, and distribute beloved brands such as Oreo, Lacta, Trident, and many more, in Brazil. Our products are available in over 700,000 points of sale and in more than 92% of Brazilian homes. Our factories are located in Vitória de Santo Antão and Curitiba, and we operate one of the company's 11 global technology centers, dedicated to R&D.

Mondelez International is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics.

Job Type: Regular, Analytics & Modelling, Data Science

title: Software Engineer (Rust)
description:
We are a global leader in the application and security industry. Our platform allows companies to operate with agility, reducing latency and increasing the reliability of their applications. We are focused on simplifying application building and looking for passionate and innovative individuals to join our team!

At Azion you will have the opportunity to develop and be connected to cutting-edge technology, immersed in a culture centered on innovation and a high-performance team, unlocking new possibilities and working with the future of technology.

About The Position

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our Engineering team at our São Paulo/SP office. As part of the Engineering department, the selected candidate will be responsible for developing highly concurrent systems in Rust, optimizing performance, distributed caching, and connection management to handle thousands of requests per second with low latency.

  • Concurrent and Asynchronous Programming: Implement highly concurrent systems in Rust, leveraging async/await and efficient thread management to handle thousands of requests per second;
  • Performance Optimization: Optimize system resource usage, including memory management and throughput maximization, ensuring low latency even under high load;
  • Distributed Caching Management: Develop and maintain efficient caching systems across a globally distributed network, addressing challenges such as consistency and cache invalidation;
  • Upstream Connection Management: Maintain stable and efficient connections with upstream services, including load balancing, automatic reconnections, and backpressure management in large-scale network communication.

Requirements

  • Experience in systems development with Rust and low-level programming;
  • Understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, and TLS;
  • Familiarity with secure development practices;
  • Familiarity with Linux and operating systems;
  • Knowledge of version control (Git);
  • Background in containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Knowledge of CI/CD and automation pipelines;

Differentials

  • Experience with Edge/CDN;
  • Experience with TCP sockets and Unix sockets;
  • Familiarity with Internet protocol RFCs;
  • Knowledge of HTTP proxy cache daemons such as Nginx, Caddy, and Envoy;

We offer a FlexWork model that prioritizes acculturation and collaboration. For the first three months, you will work on-site in the local office, an essential step in building solid relationships and a genuine connection with our values and culture. We believe that this initial immersion not only strengthens the team but also boosts creativity and innovation.

After this period, you will have the possibility to apply for the hybrid model, working on-site at least three times a week. This approach balances interaction in person and autonomy, creating a dynamic and productive working environment.

At Azion, all applications are welcome, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, pregnancy, disability, ethnicity, color, country of origin, or religion. We believe that an inclusive environment contributes to our success and that respect is present in all our relationships.

Come and join our team! We look forward to getting to know you and walking a path of success in technology together!

About Experian


Experian é uma empresa global de dados e tecnologia, que impulsiona oportunidades para pessoas e empresas ao redor do mundo. Ajudamos a redefinir práticas de empréstimo, identificar e prevenir fraudes, simplificar o setor de saúde, criar soluções de marketing e obter insights mais profundos sobre o mercado automotivo, tudo usando nossa combinação única de dados, análises e software. Operamos em diversos mercados, desde serviços financeiros até saúde, automotivo, agronegócio, seguros e muitos outros segmentos industriais.

Investimos em pessoas e novas tecnologias avançadas para desbloquear o poder dos dados. Como uma empresa do índice FTSE 100 listada na Bolsa de Valores de Londres (EXPN), temos uma equipe de 22.500 pessoas em 32 países. Nossa sede corporativa fica em Dublin, Irlanda.   • Formação superior completa;
